purpose: Freeze Task15K calibration-label collection and the limited recalibration analysis of the already frozen Task15J P3/P5 models.

label_assembly.rule: 0 only if both first-pass reviewers select review_ready; otherwise 1
label_assembly.eligibility: Only assignment coverage, exact response schema, unique response provenance, and technical_problem_flag=no are hard eligibility conditions.

calibration_model.fit: unpenalized logistic likelihood with numerically clipped raw probabilities
calibration_model.resampling: 2000 deterministic component-cluster bootstrap replicates after labels are opened
prohibited: changing P3/P5 preprocessing or feature columns
using labels to reselect P3 versus P5
creating a decision threshold before a separate utility policy is frozen

claim_boundary: This contract authorizes controlled calibration-label collection and limited probability recalibration only. It does not establish pair correctness, identity accuracy, externally confirmed calibration, deployment performance, utility, or project completion.
